edges.reason: rely() is guarded by the auth modifier which requires wards[msg.sender] == 1, so the caller controls whether the privileged write executes.
deny() is guarded by the auth modifier checking wards[msg.sender], making authorization caller-dependent.
claim() mints the new token directly to _msgSender().
levelUp() requires _isApprovedOrOwner(msg.sender, _tokenId), so msg.sender gates the state transition.
The constructor grants wards[msg.sender] = 1, giving the deploying account full privileged access.
flipSaleState() is onlyOwner and therefore depends on the caller identity supplied by _msgSender().
wards mapping value for the caller determines the auth check outcome inside rely().
wards mapping value for the caller determines the auth check outcome inside deny().
seed is initialized from block.timestamp in the constructor.
getAge() derives growthAge from block.timestamp, making the returned metadata dependent on miner-controllable time.
getAge() subtracts the stored seed from block.timestamp.
pluck() mixes seed into the keccak256 entropy input.
claim() reverts unless saleIsActive is true.
claim() writes level[_next_role] = 1 before minting.
claim() calls _safeMint, which performs an external onERC721Received callback to the recipient while mint bookkeeping is still in progress.
_safeMint invokes the recipient's onERC721Received hook, handing control to untrusted code.
_safeMint delegates the receiver check to _checkOnERC721Received.
_checkOnERC721Received performs the external IERC721Receiver.onERC721Received call to the recipient contract.
The caller identity _msgSender() is forwarded as the operator argument into the external onERC721Received callback.
claim() increments next_token after minting.
claim() reads next_token to determine the new token id.
addXp() mutates the xp mapping for the given token id.
addXp() performs xp[_tokenId] += _xp, an unchecked-by-intent accumulation path for auth callers.
addListXp() mutates the xp mapping for each token id in the batch.
addListXp() repeatedly executes xp[_tokenId] += _xp inside its loop.
levelUp() reads and writes xp[_tokenId] to check and spend xp.
levelUp() writes the incremented level back into the level mapping.
levelUp() calls xp_required(_level) to determine the spend threshold.
xp_required() computes curent_level * 1000 plus a loop-accumulated sum of i * 1000.
levelUp() executes level[_tokenId] = _level + 1.
levelUp() executes xp[_tokenId] -= _xp_required after the threshold check.
flipSaleState() negates the saleIsActive state variable.
getAge() calls pluck() to obtain the base age value.
tokenURI() calls getAge() while assembling metadata parts.
tokenURI() indirectly triggers pluck() through the individual trait getters.
pluck() calls random() to derive the pseudo-random index.
pluck() reads the seed state variable to build the entropy input string.

normalization_plan.reason: Parameter only used to index the wards mapping inside rely(); collapse into the function node.
Parameter only used to index the wards mapping inside deny(); collapse into the function node.
Token id parameter is only an index into the xp mapping within addXp().
The _xp value flows directly into the xp[_tokenId] += _xp arithmetic operation.
Array parameter driving the batch loop of addListXp().
Array parameter supplying the per-iteration xp values in addListXp().
Loop-local copy of _tokenIds[i] used solely as mapping index inside addListXp().
Loop-local copy of _xps[i] consumed directly by the xp accumulation operation.
Token id parameter indexing xp, level and owner checks inside levelUp().
Temporary cache of level[_tokenId] within levelUp().
Holds the value returned by xp_required() before the spend check in levelUp().
Level input consumed by the arithmetic inside xp_required().
Accumulator written by the multiplication and loop addition in xp_required().
Snapshot of next_token passed to _safeMint as the minted token id in claim().
Token id parameter passed through to pluck() inside getAge().
Intermediate time delta derived from block.timestamp and seed inside getAge().
Sum of plucked age and growthAge returned as a string by getAge().
